official_sources.finding: Documented UI sequence is standard policy, exception policy, product label assignment. One policy can select one or more countries; adding countries must respect other existing country policies. Verified uploaded policies take precedence over website extraction. Policy verification is separate from product serving.

Product return_policy_label selects a non-default policy. Absent values inherit default. UTF-8, non-repeated value, at most100characters in feed specification. The local proposed no_returns string is format-valid but not an actual saved policy.
Empty, missing and unmatched labels use default policy. Changing default affects every product using it; unmatched-label-first upload does not prevent default fallback.

Default and exception labels are country-bound; absent label denotes country default, label uniqueness is per country. Country values are ISO2 sale countries. processRefundDays is optional and described as processing days without a business-day conversion rule. Return shipping fee is conditional on download/print labels; no numeric fee need be invented for customer responsibility. API label limit50 is distinct from the feed100 limit.
Sales country support must be confirmed against Merchant supported countries. Policy country selection is not automatic all-market expansion; AT does not mean AU, and UK is GB.

Current product-level returns attribute can override account-level policies and avoid requiring account policies for covered offers. It is a different complex attribute from return_policy_label; current builder does not emit it. Omitted shipping fee defaults to zero, so it is not a safe shortcut for unquantified customer-paid return shipping.

Product-level feeds take precedence over account configuration; account settings take precedence over website markup. Product markup can override organization markup but is not a proven override of this saved Merchant default.
Merchant/Search Console return settings outrank website product and organization markup; markup is not an immediate account-policy synchronization mechanism.
